C0.quote: the winning party and the opposition jointly determine the tax-and-transfer policy
C0.note: Voters' votes for two parties are aggregated into power shares and policy via a power-sharing (electoral) rule. The paper studies equilibrium party competition under this rule. Borderline, since the focus is redistribution, but coded as eligible.

C1.quote: has a unique pure-strategy Nash equilibrium
C1.note: Equilibrium existence and characterisation (Props 1-2, Corollaries) plus panel regressions on real data testing the predictions. EQ has the largest share of results.
